description:
The dataset 'BFI25.csv' is loaded in Jamovi. It contains 25 personality items (A1-O5) and demographics. 

1. Create a new Computed Variable named 'Neuroticism_Mean' that calculates the mean of the five Neuroticism items (N1, N2, N3, N4, N5). 
2. Ensure 'gender' is set as a Nominal variable and 'age' as a Continuous variable. 
3. Perform a Linear Regression with 'Neuroticism_Mean' as the Dependent Variable, 'age' as a Covariate, and 'gender' as a Factor. 
4. Enable 'Confidence interval' (95%) in the Model Coefficients options. 
5. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/NeuroticismAnalysis.omv'. 
6. Create a text file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/regression_results.txt' containing the unstandardized coefficient for Age, and its Lower and Upper 95% Confidence Intervals (3 lines total).
